subject.title: chore(models): curate all provider model catalogs to current-generation lineups

question: Should maintainers accept this fleet-wide provider-catalog refresh after targeted live verification of changed onboarding defaults and the Ollama Cloud ID transition, or split the runtime/default changes from the metadata-only catalog updates?
rationale: The PR has a protected `maintainer` label and changes provider-controlled facts plus setup defaults across many extensions; repository tests establish internal consistency but cannot settle the external catalog and upgrade contract alone.

options.title: Verify representative live paths, then merge
options.body: Confirm a fresh setup, an existing configured deprecated ref, and the Ollama direct-ID plus ':cloud' alias path against live provider behavior before accepting the catalog sweep.

options.title: Split setup/runtime transitions
options.body: Land independently reviewed catalog metadata separately from onboarding-default and identifier-normalization changes if the live verification cannot be completed as one review.

recommendation.title: Verify representative live paths, then merge
recommendation.body: Confirm a fresh setup, an existing configured deprecated ref, and the Ollama direct-ID plus ':cloud' alias path against live provider behavior before accepting the catalog sweep.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged foundation and this follow-up both place this owner closest to the intended curation and compatibility policy.
